# Install My Bathroom

> Install My Bathroom is a specialist fit-only bathroom installation company based in Bracknell, Berkshire, installing luxury client-supplied bathrooms across Sunningdale, Gerrards Cross, Stoke Poges, Ascot, Windsor, Bracknell and Binfield, with 30 years' experience fitting high-end sanitaryware, stone and porcelain tiling, wet rooms and shower toilets.

## Business facts

- Legal name: Bhupinder Sahota trading as Install My Bathroom (sole trader)
- Location: Bracknell, Berkshire, RG42 4GL, United Kingdom
- Model: fit-only — clients purchase their own sanitaryware, brassware, tiles and furniture; Install My Bathroom installs it. Not a supply-and-fit or design-and-build company.
- Pricing: installation from £3,500. A paid pre-installation survey costs £125 and produces a written, fixed installation quote.
- Experience: 30 years
- Phone: 07399 651836 (WhatsApp enabled)
- Email: info@installmybathroom.co.uk
- Website: https://installmybathroom.co.uk
- Areas covered: Sunningdale, Gerrards Cross, Stoke Poges, Ascot, Windsor, Bracknell, Binfield, Winkfield, Crowthorne, Sandhurst, Warfield, Camberley, Virginia Water, Eton, Twyford, Maidenhead, Wokingham, Reading, Wentworth Estate, Sunninghill, Winkfield Row, Windlesham, Finchampstead
- Services: full bathroom installation, en-suite installation, wet room installation, walk-in shower installation, steam shower and steam room installation, freestanding bath installation, shower enclosure and screen installation, vanity unit installation, wall-hung toilet and concealed cistern installation, shower toilet installation, bidet installation, heated towel radiator installation, underfloor heating installation, large format porcelain tiling, natural stone and marble bathrooms, mirrored cabinets and illuminated mirrors, bathroom lighting and electrics, bathroom plumbing and first fix, digital and smart shower installation, bathroom ventilation, cloakroom and WC installation, accessible luxury bathrooms, bathroom strip-out and preparation, tanking and waterproofing
- Brands installed (independent installer, not affiliated with or endorsed by any of them): Geberit, Villeroy & Boch, Duravit, TOTO, AXOR, hansgrohe, Dornbracht, GROHE, Laufen, Kaldewei, Bette, Victoria + Albert, Lefroy Brooks, Burlington, Crosswater, Porcelanosa, Kohler, Matki
- Regulated trades (gas, Part P electrical, unvented hot water) are carried out by appropriately registered engineers coordinated by Install My Bathroom
- No star ratings, review counts or case studies are published until genuine client reviews exist — this is a deliberate policy, not an oversight

## Services

- [All Services](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/): Hub listing all 24 fit-only installation services
- [Full Bathroom Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/full-bathroom-installation/): Strip-out, tanking, tiling and second fix of client-supplied sanitaryware
- [En-Suite Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/ensuite-installation/): Compact layouts, tanking, tiling and second fix of client-supplied products
- [Wet Room Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/wet-room-installation/): Tanked, level-access floors with a tested fall to drain
- [Walk-In Shower Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/walk-in-shower-installation/): Low-profile trays, glass panels, tanked and tiled
- [Steam Shower & Steam Room Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/steam-shower-and-steam-room-installation/): Sealed enclosures, dedicated electrics, tested commissioning
- [Freestanding Bath Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/freestanding-bath-installation/): Floor loading, waste routing and precise tap positioning
- [Shower Enclosure & Screen Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/shower-enclosure-and-screen-installation/): Framed, frameless and bath screens, sealed to a tanked substrate
- [Vanity Unit Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/vanity-unit-installation/): Wall-hung or floor-standing, concealed pipework, basin and worktop fitted to spec
- [Wall-Hung Toilet & Concealed Cistern Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/wall-hung-toilet-and-concealed-cistern-installation/): Carrier frame, access panel and precise set-out
- [Shower Toilet Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/shower-toilet-installation/): Power, water supply and concealed cistern compatibility checked at survey
- [Bidet Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/bidet-installation/): Hot/cold supply, waste routing and space checked at survey
- [Heated Towel Radiator Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/heated-towel-radiator-installation/): Central heating, dual-fuel and electric, output sized to the room
- [Underfloor Heating Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/underfloor-heating-installation/): Electric and wet systems under porcelain or natural stone, correctly commissioned
- [Large Format Porcelain Tiling](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/large-format-porcelain-tiling/): Lippage checked row by row, full-coverage adhesive, set out from centre lines
- [Natural Stone & Marble Bathrooms](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/natural-stone-and-marble-bathrooms/): Sealing, book-matching and mitred edges
- [Mirrored Cabinets & Illuminated Mirrors](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/mirrored-cabinets-and-illuminated-mirrors/): Electrical zones, recessing and positioning checked
- [Bathroom Lighting & Electrics](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/bathroom-lighting-and-electrics/): Zoned to BS 7671, Part P certified
- [Bathroom Plumbing & First Fix](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/bathroom-plumbing-and-first-fix/): Supply runs, waste falls, pipe centres and pressure testing
- [Digital & Smart Shower Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/digital-and-smart-shower-installation/): Processor siting, access panels and commissioning
- [Bathroom Ventilation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/bathroom-ventilation/): Extractor fan and ducting sized to Part F requirements
- [Cloakroom & WC Installation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/cloakroom-and-wc-installation/): Concealed cisterns, compact furniture and precise small-room tiling
- [Accessible Luxury Bathrooms](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/accessible-luxury-bathrooms/): Level-access wet rooms with solid fixing points and non-institutional finishes
- [Bathroom Strip-Out & Preparation](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/bathroom-strip-out-and-preparation/): Strip-out, disposal and substrate preparation
- [Tanking & Waterproofing](https://installmybathroom.co.uk/services/tanking-and-waterproofing/): To BS 5385 guidance — falls formed before the membrane, corners reinforced, cured before tiling
